text:
dylan: Quick pre-read for tomorrow's design review — I prototyped two new patterns for pinned models: a compact breadcrumb ribbon above the table and an overlay star anchored to the selection column. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/newflow/pin-ribbon-vs-overlay :mag:

amira: Nice. The ribbon keeps rows clean but I'm worried users won't notice it unless we animate the first pin. The overlay star is discoverable but might clash with row selection.

samir: My read: ribbon is great for low-clutter UIs, overlay star is better for discoverability and mobile. We should test both with an initial onboarding pulse for the ribbon.

tessa: Accessibility note: ribbon must be role=region with aria-label 'Pinned models', and each crumb should be a button with aria-pressed. Overlay star must have aria-pressed plus sr-only text that reads latency and cost values.

dylan: Microcopy proposal: ribbon tooltip text 'Pinned models for side-by-side compare' and toast when hidden by filters: 'Pinned model hidden by filters. Show pinned models? [Show]'. Avoid the word version.

amira: Also add a small metric chip inside crumbs: latency (ms) and unit cost on hover. Ensure contrast >= 4.5:1. For colorblind accessibility add an icon letter L/M/H next to chip.

samir: Dev constraints: ribbon is a separate DOM region above the virtualized list so we need to keep it virtualized for large tables. Overlay star can be absolute-positioned in-row to avoid shifting columns. Both approaches need analytics to measure discoverability.

tessa: Keyboard flows: star or crumb should be tabbable. Use Space/Enter and set aria-pressed true/false. Also support a 'P' shortcut when a row is focused. Example:

```
<button class="pin-toggle" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Toggle pin for compare">⭐</button>
```

amira: Edge-case: if user pins and then applies a filter excluding it, offer a non-blocking toast with Show. If they click Show, pinned models are promoted to top and highlighted for 3s. That avoids jarring auto-scroll.

dylan: For localization: crumb labels need truncation rules and a tooltip with full model+variant name. Ribbon should allow horizontal scroll for many pins.

samir: Analytics plan: pin.toggled {pattern: ribbon|overlay, method: click|keyboard|shortcut}, pin.revealed_by_filter, ribbon.dismissed. We'll use these to decide default.

tessa: A11y nit: perf badge inside the ribbon must have sr-only text like 'Latency 23ms; Cost $0.002 per 1k' and focusable tooltip triggers. Do not rely on hover only.

amira: UX experiment idea: roll out ribbon as default for new users and overlay for existing users, measure time-to-find pinned + unpin rate. Also run a small 5-person usability on both before wider rollout.

dylan: I'll prepare two clickable prototypes (ribbon with onboarding pulse, overlay star with persistent hint) and drop them in the thread before 10:00. Please review keyboard/copy.

ux-bot: Created ticket UX-8200: "Pinned ribbon vs overlay star — prototypes + a11y + analytics" and attached Figma frames.

product-ops: Added acceptance criteria: pinned control is keyboard reachable, aria-pressed implemented, ribbon is labelled and scrollable, perf badges meet contrast or have text/icon fallback, toast for hidden pins implemented, analytics emitted. Assigned to eng-frontend.

dylan: Thanks all — will demo both patterns in the review. Ping if you want early access to prototypes. :thumbsup:
